# BLAKE2 reference implementation

Unmodified portable C sources from https://github.com/BLAKE2/BLAKE2,
revision `ed1974ea83433eba7b2d95c5dcd9ac33cb847913`, directory `ref/`.

PinHZ uses these sources under the CC0 1.0 option offered by the authors.
Copyright notices and upstream license options are retained in the sources and COPYING.
Compiled directly into the application; no additional runtime DLL is needed.
